components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main commit action for sign-in, save, and create flows.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #7C3AED 0%, #EC4899 100%); color: #FFFFFF; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px 16px; font-family: Poppins, 'Noto Sans Thai', 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; letter-spacing: 0.01em; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(168,85,247,0.3); transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), filter 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), box-shadow 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); filter: brightness(1.08); box-shadow: 0 14px 28px rgba(168,85,247,0.32); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8B5CF6; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); filter: brightness(0.98); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Lower-priority action with frosted neutral treatment.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.78); color: #6D28D9; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.64); border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px 16px; font-family: Poppins, 'Noto Sans Thai', 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; letter-spacing: 0.01em; transition: background-color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), border-color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.92); border-color: rgba(139,92,246,0.35); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8B5CF6; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Core text field style used across auth, categories, and settings.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; max-width: 360px; } .ds-field-label { font-family: Poppins, 'Noto Sans Thai', 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; color: #374151; } .ds-input { width: 100%; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.78); color: #1F2937; border: 1px solid rgba(209,213,219,0.95); border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px 16px; font-family: Poppins, 'Noto Sans Thai', 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.5; transition: border-color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), box-shadow 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), background-color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-input:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.9); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #8B5CF6; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(139,92,246,0.28); background: #FFFFFF; } .ds-input:active { border-color: #7C3AED; }

components.name: Glass Card
components.description: Default content container for modules, forms, and analytics sections.
components.html:
Current Streak

Track consistency and momentum over time.
components.css: .ds-card { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); color: #1F2937; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.6); border-radius: 12px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(124,58,237,0.12); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), box-shadow 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 16px 34px rgba(124,58,237,0.18); } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8B5CF6; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0 0 8px; font-family: Poppins, 'Noto Sans Thai', 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.35; } .ds-card-copy { margin: 0; font-family: Poppins, 'Noto Sans Thai', 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.6; color: #6B7280; }

components.name: Top Navigation Tab
components.description: Segmented tab-style navigation for primary app sections.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 8px; padding: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.6); border-radius: 12px; background: linear-gradient(115deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.72), rgba(255,255,255,0.58), rgba(245,232,255,0.58), rgba(255,255,255,0.72)); } .ds-nav-item { border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.7); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.72); color: rgba(88,28,135,0.72); border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px 16px; font-family: Poppins, 'Noto Sans Thai', 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), box-shadow 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), background-color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-item:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); background: #FFFFFF; color: #7C3AED; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8B5CF6; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-item:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-nav-item--active { border: 0; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #7C3AED 0%, #EC4899 100%); color: #FFFFFF; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(168,85,247,0.3); }

narrative.overview:
The interface should feel like a lightweight personal command surface that stays beautiful under daily repetition. Visual polish exists to reduce friction and preserve momentum, not to perform as decoration. Core actions should read instantly, feel direct, and respond with calm confidence.

The system blends soft glass layering with vivid lilac-pink accents so habit completion and task updates feel rewarding without turning noisy. It explicitly rejects cluttered dashboard interfaces, crowded card stacks, and decorative patterns that slow interaction. It also rejects heavy or distracting motion that competes with core actions.
keyCharacteristics: Soft translucent surfaces with clear hierarchy.
High-clarity action states in violet and pink.
Compact spacing tuned for fast daily check-ins.
Motion used for confirmation and orientation only.

rules.name: The Momentum Accent Rule
rules.body: Accent colors exist to reveal action and progress, never as generic decoration.

rules.name: The Soft Surface Rule
rules.body: Surface contrast should come from tinted layers and subtle borders, not stark black-white blocks.

rules.name: The One-Glance Rule
rules.body: Any daily action screen must be readable in one quick scan, so weights and sizes must keep hierarchy obvious at a glance.

rules.name: The Response-Only Depth Rule
rules.body: Depth intensifies only when user intent or focus changes, never as idle ornament.

dos: Do keep primary actions visually obvious with violet/pink emphasis and clear hover/focus response.
Do preserve compact, fast interaction paths for daily habit check-offs and task capture.
Do use translucent surfaces, soft borders, and ambient shadows to separate layers gently.
Do keep motion short and purposeful, especially for confirmation, orientation, and feedback.
donts: Don't add decorative patterns that slow interaction.
Don't use heavy or distracting motion that competes with core actions.
Don't use side-stripe borders or gradient text as decorative shortcuts.
